# Kotlin/JVM Template

A Copier template for the Kotlin/JVM Gradle library generated by this repository.

## Generate a Project

```shell
copier copy gh:Virtlink/kotlin-jvm-template my-library
```

## Develop the Template

```shell
git clone https://github.com/Virtlink/kotlin-jvm-template.git
cd kotlin-jvm-template
nix develop
copier copy . ../my-library
```

The default development shell supplies JDK 21 and Copier.
